alpha_finance.method: Five-fund flow series; page says daily values are net creations/redemptions and flow prints describe prior sessions.

xrp_insights.method: Six US spot funds plus BITW; holdings/AUM and flow series are not the same measurement.

etf_flow_reconciliation.reconciliation: Do not average. Alpha Finance covers five funds and reports USD net flows; XRP Insights covers six spot funds plus BITW and reports XRP holdings changes and AUM. ETF redemptions can reflect arbitrage unwinds and flows settle with timing lags; neither dashboard alone establishes contemporaneous spot selling.
